_meta.description: 200 response for PUT /api/tesla/vehicles/{vehicleId}/service-window (MYR-316) — the owner's 'expected back' entry. Authored here from the locked endpoint contract because the telemetry repo ships no fixture for this endpoint (docs/contracts/fixtures/rest/ covers read paths only); replace with the upstream file the moment one exists. The echoed value is the server's RESOLVED serviceEstimatedEndAt, which is NOT necessarily what the owner submitted: Tesla's own service_data.service_etc outranks the owner's entry. Clients adopt THIS value, never the string they sent — there is no WebSocket delta for serviceEstimatedEndAt.
